parameters.content:
## Manual research pilot
Select your own Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_KEY. No key belongs in this JSON. Edit Research input, leave Sheets disabled, inspect the HTTP and mapping results. Configure a scratch sheet using the companion headers before enabling writes. No scheduling, automatic pagination or retries. Reruns may charge credits and append duplicates. Successful full run makes TWO API requests, profile then posts.
